newsitem.title: USA: Rexworks names interim president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Rexworks names interim president, CEO.

text.p: Rexworks Inc said Thursday Laurance Newman, a consultant for the company, has been named interim president and chief executive officer, replacing Michael Hadjinian.
Hadjinian, who is becoming president and chief executive officer of Accutec, a private Milwaukee-based company, said he will remain chairman of Rexworks.
A search committee will be formed to find a permanent successor for Hadjinian as president and chief executive officer, said Thomas Lauerman, Rexworks chief financial officer.
Shares of Rexworks, which makes truck mounted concrete mixers, landfill compactors and materials reduction products, were untraded Thursday morning.
